AUTHORISED DISTRIBUTORSHIP LETTER
Effective Date: 1 January 2026
Validity: Until 31 December 2027
To Whom It May Concern,
This letter hereby certifies that:
OPTA LLC, with registered business address at ?? + CNPJ tax ID, is appointed as a non-exclusive Authorized Distributor of Zhengzhou Saga Telecom Co., Ltd. (“Saga Telecom”) for the territory of Brazil during the validity period of this authorization.
1. Scope of Authorization
OPTA LLC is granted the non-exclusive right to market, promote, distribute, sell and provide after-sales technical support for Saga Telecom’s full range of products in Brazil.
Including but not limited to:
Commercial Ethernet
Industrial Networking
High-Speed Networks
Other Related Telecom & Networking Equipment
This authorization does not grant any right of sublicensing or appointing secondary distributors unless otherwise approved in writing by Saga Telecom.
2. Distributor Responsibilities
OPTA LLC is responsible for:
Promoting Saga Telecom products in the Brazilian market
Conducting sales, customer support, and local technical assistance
Maintaining brand integrity and complying with applicable local regulations
Providing feedback regarding market demands and customer requirements
This authorization does not permit the distributor to enter into any binding agreements on behalf of Saga Telecom.
3. International Trade Terms(Incoterms Responsibility Disclaimer)
Saga Telecom hereby clarifies that all product deliveries related to this authorization are strictly conducted under EXW (Ex Works) or FOB (Free On Board) Incoterms.
Accordingly:
Saga Telecom is NOT responsible for any import procedures in Brazil
Saga Telecom does NOT undertake customs clearance, tax payments, ANATEL certification, regulatory approvals, or any logistics operations within Brazilian territory
Saga Telecom shall NOT be held liable for any delays, penalties, or costs arising from the distributor’s handling of import procedures or regulatory compliance in Brazil
All responsibilities related to Brazilian customs clearance, import documentation, regulatory compliance, taxes, duties, and domestic transportation shall be fully borne by the distributor, OPTA LLC
Saga Telecom’s responsibility ends at the point of EXW/FOB delivery per the confirmed trade terms
This clause is binding for all transactions conducted under this authorization
4. Contact Information
Issued by: Zhengzhou Saga Telecom Co., Ltd.
Signed: Simon Cheng, Director of Sales
Company Stamp
Date: 2025.12.08
Accepted and Agreed: OPTA LLC
Signed:
